lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: How was Steven acting when you got up north?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Like he was trying to runaway, trying ta, trying to figure out when, how to get away from the cops.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did he ever ask you to go with him?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No. (shakes head “no”)

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did he he ever make any threats to you?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No. (shakes head “no”)

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did he tell you anything about this as far as, what did he tell you after this?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He didn’t tell me nothin’, (shakes head “no”) he was just trying to leave.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: And then grandpa said that if you, you, if you’re gonna try to leave, then that means you did it. (pause) So he sat back down.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Anyone else in the family, up north, say anything to him like that or about that type of stuff?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: uh uh (shakes head “no”)

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: You said um, (pause) I-I’ve got some tough questions for you OK? (Brendan nods “yes”) Ah, but just be honest. I need you to, to the best of your memory, describe Teresa's body to me.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Like before we a put her in there, in the fire?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Probably when she was alive, did she have any scars, marks, tattoos, stuff like that, that you can remember?
